description.text: Objectives: This program fosters students of computer science and technology who have good scientific quality, and master systematically basic theories, knowledge, skills and methods of computer science and technology. They are expected to be able to carry out professional teaching, scientific research and exploration of computer, and computer application in governmental institutions, enterprises, administrative departments, research institutions and schools. They are expected to launch computer auditing, and scientific research, teaching and application work concerned with information technology of management usage. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Science Degree Main Courses: Circuit Principle, Emulation Electronic Technique and Signal Processing, Numerical Circuits and Logic Design, Discrete Mathematics, Constitute Principle of Computer, Operation System, Data Structure, Assembly Language, Computer Systems Architecture, Microcomputer Technique, System Analysis and Design, Database Principle, Compiling Principle, Computer Network, and Software Engineering etc.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Nanjing Audit University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school

requirements.text: 1. HSK level 3 or above 2. High school graduate
